metin.Power Up Store'da kuponla indirim — Spon: Discounts with coupons in the Power Up Store — support your Sponsor Streamer
metin.SexyKO olarak Power Up Store sistemine ç: At SexyKO we've added a very special and different feature to the Power Up Store: with this system you can now use Sponsor Streamers' discount codes in your PUS purchases and complete your shopping at a better price.
metin.Bu özellik, SexyKO ve StoneSoft altyapıs: This feature is a special structure built directly into the PUS system on the SexyKO and StoneSoft infrastructure. **Players get a discount on their purchases and also support the Sponsor Streamer they back.**
metin.İNDİRİM KODU NASIL KULLANILIR?: HOW TO USE A DISCOUNT CODE?
metin.Power Up Store'un alt bölümünde bulunan: Just type the discount code you want to use in the Coupon field at the bottom of the Power Up Store. Then click the **CHECK** button.
metin.**Kod geçerliyse indirim otomatik olarak: **If the code is valid, the discount is activated automatically.** So you can complete your purchase at the discounted price.
metin.İndirim kodları yalnızca sepet alışveriş: Discount codes can be used not only for basket purchases but also on eligible single PUS items. If you have a valid coupon code when buying the item, the discount is applied directly to the purchase.
metin.**Yani tek bir ürün alırken bile Sponsor: **So you can use a Sponsor Streamer discount code even when buying a single item.**
metin.PUS üzerinde birden fazla ürünü Basket i: You can also use the coupon system when you add several items to the Basket in PUS. The discount is applied to eligible items in the basket and your total is recalculated accordingly.
metin.**Bu sayede toplu PUS alışverişlerinde d: **This way you can benefit from coupons on bulk PUS purchases too.**
metin.Bunun nedeni bu paketlerin zaten birden: That's because these packs are already made by combining several items and are sold at a better price than their normal total.
metin.Bu ürünler hali hazırda paket indirimi i: Since these items already include a pack discount, **a second coupon discount is not applied.**
metin.Kupon sisteminin önemli amaçlarından bir: One of the main purposes of the coupon system is to support SexyKO Sponsor Streamers. Special discount codes can be set up for Sponsor Streamers.
metin.**Oyuncular:** Sponsor Yayıncının kodunu: **Players:** use the Sponsor Streamer's code → get a discount on the PUS purchase → support the Sponsor Streamer.
metin.Böylece hem oyuncu avantaj kazanır hem d: So the player gets an advantage and the SexyKO streamer community is supported.
metin.Özel etkinlik ve kampanya dönemlerinde S: During special event and campaign periods, Sponsor Streamer coupons can activate: **🎉 UP TO 30% DISCOUNTS**. These special codes may not always be active.
